description: The first-element assertion of the OCCURS 9 admin menu table, gate G33, made on the rejection path that composes it. OPTIONI arrives blank, so the descending scan at app/cbl/COADM01C.cbl:117-121 stops at WS-IDX 1 because byte 2 is a space, line 122 moves that single space into the JUST RIGHT receiver, line 123's INSPECT REPLACING ALL ' ' BY '0' turns both bytes into '0', and OPTIONO therefore echoes '00' - which reaches the THIRD term of the guard at line 129, WS-OPTION = ZEROS, rather than the first or the second. Line 133 performs SEND-MENU-SCREEN and line 137's IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON is then false, so no transfer follows. SEND-MENU-SCREEN performs BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS at line 175, which is why the twelve menu lines ARE composed here and why this rejection is the right place to pin the first element: the table is built on this path by the same paragraph a first paint uses. The loop at line 228 is PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1, so subscript 1 addresses the FIRST entry, and the EVALUATE arm WHEN 1 at lines 239-240 moves it to OPTN001O - COBOL subscript 1 is Java list position 0 and screen slot OPTN001O, and a 0-based read of the 1-based subscript would render option 2's label in slot 1. OPTN002O is pinned beside OPTN001O precisely so a one-slot shift fails loudly here instead of being merely suspected. Each line is derived mechanically from app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy: CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NUM is PIC 9(02), so entry 1 renders '01' WITH its leading zero and not '1'; CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NAME is PIC X(35), so 'User List (Security)' keeps the fifteen trailing spaces of its literal and is NOT trimmed; and line 231 blanks WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT PIC X(40) before the STRING at 233-236 writes 2 + 2 + 35 = 39 characters, so character 40 stays the space line 231 put there because STRING overwrites only what it writes. app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy:20 values four entries of a table declared OCCURS 9 at line 45, and that is asserted as shipped rather than tidied: the loop runs 1 to 4 only, so OPTN005O to OPTN012O come back as the unpainted X'00' image and all twelve are carried because the symbolic map declares twelve. Every width comes from the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COADM01.CPY - OPTN00nI PIC X(40) and OPTIONI PIC X(2) - and never from the LENGTH= operand of app/bms/COADM01.bms. Only the thirteen items the service observably produces are pinned; the six header items POPULATE-HEADER-INFO fills at lines 202-221 and the 78-byte ERRMSGO belong to the controller projection and are pinned by case02, case15 and case20, which is also why the message here is the 80-byte WS-MESSAGE of line 38 rather than the narrower screen field line 177 moves it into. ERRMSGC is the map's declared COLOR=RED at app/bms/COADM01.bms:154-157, not a CSSETATY highlight - COADM01C does not copy CSSETATY - and line 148's DFHGREEN overrides it on the coming-soon path alone, which case08 drives. Nothing in the communication area is mutated on this path: CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 1 because line 88's SET happened on the earlier keystroke and it is still 1 on the way out. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:32, the instant COADM01C's own version footer at line 267 carries, so one clock governs all twenty cases in this directory even where, as here, no header is painted for it to reach; US-ASCII is named explicitly rather than left to a platform default. The complementary shapes are case05 for the first guard term, case06 and case18 for the second, case20 for this same term through the controller, and case12, case13 and case14 for the first iteration, the last iteration and the eight never-written slots on the first-entry paint. Every expected value above is STATICALLY DERIVED - read out of the COBOL paragraph that produces it and cross-checked against the copybook byte layout of app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COADM01.CPY and the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COADM01.bms - and NOT captured from an execution of the legacy program, which is empirically impossible in this environment: no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository. ParityHarness's class documentation is the authoritative statement of that provenance, and the substitution is escalated rather than absorbed - risk R-A.
